title: Reference Mark
description: What the original produced for one Input Trace: the Mark in sim units (frames or the original's pixels), how it was displayed, and any intermediate measurements. See calibration/PROTOCOL.md.

trace.description: Id of the Input Trace this belongs to. The file lives at the same relative path under calibration/reference/.

marks.description: One entry per human player in the trace.

measurements.description: Intermediate values read while frame-stepping, keyed by name (camelCase). Units go in the name or in 'units'. Examples: takeOffFrame, speedPerFrame, releaseAngle, rivalX.

units.description: Unit of each measurement, keyed by the same name: 'frames', 'pixels', 'pixelsPerFrame', 'degrees', 'meterUnits' or a short description.

tool.description: Emulator or hardware and version used.

outcome.description: valid: a Mark was recorded. foul: overstepped or released past the line. falseStart: left before the gun. failed: no Mark for another reason (e.g. knocked the bar).

value.description: The Mark in sim units, or null when there is none.

unit.description: frames for times; pixels (the original's) for distances and heights.

display.description: Exactly what the original showed for this Mark, including punctuation, or null if nothing was shown.
